summary: No actionable finding in the accepted RS-25 restructuring. Checked both member documents and all 13 stages, 14 family leads, 25 ownership records and 60 links, including the review's ModularCurves 0E correction. Three narrowed interfaces retain their non-imported targets and all recorded consumers; no RS-25 edge creates a cycle in the checked graph unions.
checked: Read accepted RS-25 JSON/report, REV-RS-25 and family evidence at atlas commit 15a7adf64cd502872225d25c2db7b0d823cd887a. Independent of author cg-6b83f1 and reviewer cc-442dc5.

Compared the complete NeronModelsAndSemistableAbelianVarieties and SchemeAndStackFoundations documents and all 13 stages with all keep/narrow decisions; no moved, dropped, retired or upstream-mutated stage.

Read all 14 family evidence leads, not treating duplicate-audit wording as a verdict. Rejected the proposed identification of smooth Picard integration with semistable degeneration and of general abelian reduction with curve reduction.

Read supplier contracts: EllipticCurves 4 and the conductor subsection of 8; StableReduction 1,2,4,5,6,7,8,9; JacobianChallenge D/F; ModularCurves 0E; ArithmeticGaloisRepresentations R01.3/R01.6. Compared every ownership record with its named scope.

Read all 13 reviewed data/library-coverage.json member entries and directly checked AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme and Scheme.Hom at Mathlib 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174 and NumericalType weightedIntersection/principalDivisors/Pic/Coker/picToCoker/picToCoker_injective at Tau Ceti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369. Other implementation-status statements remain attributed to the reviewed audit, not a new absence search.

Read Stacks 01NM, 0CCJ, 0C7H and 0CE7 on 2026-09-30; checked general relative-Proj scope, finite-locally-free descent-cover restrictions and weighted Picard comparison. Recomputed the rank-one Smith invariants for the report's weighted/unweighted two-component example.

Checked all 60 link pairs for endpoint resolution, uniqueness, non-self direction and source/consumer compatibility; inspected all nine external consumers of the narrowed SF stages and retained internal consumers.
Checked forwarding from every suppliedBy stage to its narrowed interface and every recorded direct consumer. SF.0 has six consumers, SF.1 four, SF.4 four; no missing pair.

Checked adjacent accepted ownership entries in RS-08/17/18/32. They agree on SF.5, R11.4, R11.3 and the distinction between finite-level H1/Jacobian comparison and general arithmetic Tate enhancements.

Ran target-to-source reachability for each proposed edge on native stageEdges plus requires plus RS-25 (3568 edges), plus all 25 accepted link maps (4174), plus all 27 applied restructuring proposals (7007): no return path in any mode.

Ran the actual restructure.apply_restructurings with other accepted proposals first: all 60 RS-25 links apply, no skipped link. Applied RS-25 alone: every previous stage ID and edge preserved. Ran check_restructure.check on the pinned target/family/atlas: no errors.

Re-fetched main through 1823c502a4d131083effaca47c7c9cb04915a8ad and compared the target, review, family, member/anchor documents, atlas, reviewed coverage and applied-restructure inputs with the audit base: unchanged.

stageChecks.assessment: Local excellent-DVR existence and Dedekind gluing, all-smooth-test mapping property, finite type, uniqueness/homomorphisms, differential lattices and allowed unramified base change remain. SF.4 only imports them.

General component/toric/abelian data and isogeny sequences remain. EC4 supplies equation filtration and algorithmic indices; identifying them with geometric components remains new work, including wild primes and rational versus geometric points.

General abelian semistability, inertia criterion, Raynaud extension and lattice/polarization-sensitive formal or analytic uniformisation remain. Neither SR7 curve reduction nor EC4 point-level Tate uniformisation replaces them.

Semistable Picard/generalized Jacobian, graph characters, monodromy and integral Neron-component comparisons remain. Smooth Jacobian D, SR1 nodal graphs and SR6 weighted numerical specialization are separate inputs, not identifications with the output.

General NOS, isogeny invariance, good/semistable comparisons and local factors with monodromy remain. EC4 supplies the three elliptic NOS scopes; R01.3 conductors, R01.6 Tate modules, R06.6 p-adic comparison and EC8 semistable conductor compatibility are imported.

Degeneracy-compatible character/monodromy exports, R25/R28 inputs and the R29 invariant dictionary remain. Existing equation invariants, differential lattices and regular-model geometry are compared, not redefined.

Relative Spec and general relative Proj, affine/twist/base-change compatibility and named-arrow tests remain. SR2 owns only its finitely generated graded-algebra construction; library schemes, modules and gluing are reused.

Retained effective object classes exclude both SR2 polarized etale descent and ModularCurves 0E classes. Quotients, diagonals, atlas independence and coarse/fine versus stack distinctions remain; no universal scheme effectivity or properness is inferred.
Sites, coefficients, localization, base change and compact support remain, with CPC and etale-duality integration rather than a new six-operations owner.

Smooth-curve divisors, Riemann-Roch, duality, genus, Picard/Jacobian and Abel-Jacobi integration remain, as do scalar extension and Tate/cohomology comparisons. Degenerate Picard/Neron theory is not substituted for the smooth input.

Infinitesimal lifting, obstructions, formal geometry/algebraization and source-scoped birational results remain. R11.1/R11.3 and SR7/8/9 supply distinct model/reduction outputs with their own extension and genus hypotheses.
General Chow/Gysin/Chern, GRR, Hodge index, surface Riemann-Roch, adjunction and graph/diagonal route remain. SR4 arithmetic-surface intersection is an imported special case, not the whole theory.
Cohomology-comparison maps and cycle/trace/pairing compatibility remain coefficient-, topology- and completion-sensitive consumer interfaces, not additional definitions of the source theories.

limitations: This is a complete attack on this restructuring decision, not a complete blueprint or theorem-proof audit of every retained programme.
No exhaustive fresh proof transcription of BLR/Faltings-Chai, general monodromy, Raynaud algebraization or all retained scheme-foundation targets. Their proof leaves remain later blueprint work.
Graph result is that no RS-25 edge participates in a cycle in the stated unions, not a certificate that every unrelated atlas component or future theorem-level dependency is acyclic.
Coarse forwarding is retained as the documented access convention, not evidence that every downstream proof uses every supplier theorem.
No Lean deliverable, compilation, formalization claim or new declaration.
